# Mailbox Plus - Concord Township Pack & Ship

> Concord Township's premier independent pack-and-ship center and private mailbox provider, offering multi-carrier shipping, professional packing, notary, and virtual mailbox services.

Mailbox Plus is a locally-owned, community-focused business in Concord Township, Ohio. Unlike single-carrier franchises, we compare rates for UPS, FedEx, USPS, and DHL side-by-side at our counter so users can choose the cheapest or fastest option. We specialize in secure private mailbox rentals, walk-in notary public services, digital fingerprinting, and expert custom packing for fragile, heavy, or specialty items.
